Awesome.activateHint: This action creates your personal field until your next ten-minute or longer recovery.
Awesome.restoreHint: Confirm that your next turn has begun outside the original combat.
Awesome.shatterHint: Spend {cost} Intellect points to cancel the residual wound from this Intellect Block? Your field is unavailable until your next turn.
Awesome.shatteredCost: Field shattered: wound cancelled, {cost} Intellect points spent.
Awesome.barrierHint: Declare the shape and placement within short range. Level 6, nonphysical; expires at your ten-minute or longer recovery. Each additional intact barrier requires one more dedicated Effort level. Cube/sphere: immediate distance across. Wall: immediate high and short wide, or vice versa. Path: horizontal wall. Stops at solid obstacles, exerts no pressure and blocks gas. Geometry and passage are adjudicated by the GM.
Awesome.inRange: I confirm the placement is within short range
Awesome.endHint: End this barrier? Its object remains as history; paid costs are retained.
Awesome.captureHint: Confirm this NPC was inside at creation and this is still the creation action. Roll an Intellect attack without damage. The first target shares creation Effort and Edge; further targets use their own attack allocation.
Awesome.reconcileHint: An attack was started but its result was not acknowledged. Record the observed result; no dice or costs are repeated. If the result is unknown, adjudicate it explicitly.
Awesome.releaseHint: Confirm this creature left the barrier. Later damage corrections will not return it inside.
Awesome.crossing: This action must cross a barrier
Awesome.crossingHint: An intact force barrier prevents the declared crossing before costs. Attacking the barrier itself remains possible. The GM determines line of effect; token positions are not measured.
Awesome.unavailable: This field action is unavailable. Check ownership, source, turn, state and resources.
